The list endpoint is correctly switched to a visibility-filtered query, but the detail endpoint fix is applied to the wrong controller method. The shown `manageBoxByCode` method appears before the actual `@GetMapping("/content/boxes/{code}")` storefront method; that latter method remains unchanged and still returns hidden boxes.

Therefore hidden-box detail tests will fail. Existing tests may also be affected by the added interface methods, but the endpoint gap alone is decisive.
